title: MRP Declaration Presence

source_reference: LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(e) (as amended by G.S.R. 779(E) & 226(E))

title: Net Quantity Declaration Presence
description: Evaluates whether reliable Net Quantity declaration evidence exists.

title: Manufacturer/Packer Declaration Presence
description: Evaluates whether reliable Manufacturer or Packer declaration evidence exists.
source_reference: LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(a) (as amended by G.S.R. 629(E))

title: Importer Declaration Presence
description: Evaluates whether reliable Importer declaration evidence exists.
source_reference: LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(a) (as amended by G.S.R. 629(E))

title: Consumer Care Declaration Presence
description: Evaluates whether reliable Consumer Care declaration evidence exists.

title: Country of Origin Declaration Presence
description: Verifies the presence of the country of origin, manufacture, or assembly for imported products.
source_reference: LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(aa) (as amended by G.S.R. 629(E), 23 June 2017)

title: Common/Generic Name Declaration Presence
description: Verifies the presence of the common or generic name of the commodity.

title: Unit Sale Price Declaration Presence
description: Verifies the presence of the unit sale price for non-exempt commodities. Amendment chain: introduced G.S.R. 779(E) (2 Nov 2021); substituted G.S.R. 226(E) (28 Mar 2022); exempted G.S.R. 722(E) (6 Oct 2023).
source_reference: LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(11) (introduced by G.S.R. 779(E), substituted by G.S.R. 226(E), amended by G.S.R. 722(E))

title: Unit Sale Price Denominator Consistency
description: Verifies that the printed unit sale price denominator complies with Rule 6(11) boundaries. Amendment chain: introduced G.S.R. 779(E) (2 Nov 2021); substituted G.S.R. 226(E) (28 Mar 2022); exempted G.S.R. 722(E) (6 Oct 2023).
source_reference: LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(11) (introduced by G.S.R. 779(E), substituted by G.S.R. 226(E), amended by G.S.R. 722(E))

title: Month/Year Declaration Presence (Pre-2024)
description: Verifies presence of manufacture, packed, or import month/year.

title: Month/Year Declaration Presence (2024+)
description: Verifies presence of manufacture month/year only.
source_reference: LMPC Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(d) (as amended by G.S.R. 779(E), effective date deferred to 01-01-2024 via G.S.R. 714(E))
